title: Server Auctions
description: A lightweight Fabric economy mod featuring a global auction house GUI and physical, interactive shop stands styled with red carpets.
body:
# Server Auctions

A lightweight economy and trading mod for Fabric 1.21.4. Combine a global virtual auction house with physical, interactive player shop stands!

## Features at a Glance

*   **Global Auction House (`/auction`):** List and buy items from anywhere using an intuitive chest GUI. Filter by "My Listings" to easily manage your auctions.
*   **Auction Blocks (Bazaar Stands):** Placeable scaffolding stands with a red carpet. Players can walk through them (with a slight slowness effect) and climb them like ladders.
*   **Interactive Shops:** Place items in your block and set custom prices. Other players can hover to see the seller/price and click to buy instantly.
*   **Grief Protection:** Only the owner who placed the Auction Block (or an OP) can break it.
*   **Live Chat Feedback:** Sellers receive instant chat notifications showing who bought their items and how much they paid.
*   **Financial Stats (`/balance stats`):** Track detailed statistics showing exactly how you earned (sell, auction, block) and spent your money.
*   **Server Economy:** Precise balances down to the cent, direct player payments (`/balance pay`), and instant server selling (`/sell`).

## Commands

*   `/auction` — Open the global marketplace.
*   `/balance` — Check your pocket money.
*   `/balance stats` — View your earning and spending history.
*   `/balance pay <player> <amount>` — Send money to another player.
*   `/sell` — Instantly sell the item in your hand to the server.
*   `/balance <add/remove> <player> <amount>` — *(OP Only)* Edit player balances.

## Crafting

Craft the Auction Block using:
*   **2x Gold Ingots** (top left and top right slots)
*   **4x Wood Planks** (forming a U-shape in the middle and bottom rows)
